powers.name: Touch of Darkness
powers.summary: As a melee touch attack, make a creature treat all other creatures as concealed, imposing a 20% miss chance on its attacks for rounds equal to half cleric level, minimum 1. Uses per day equal 3 + Wisdom modifier.

powers.name: Eyes of Darkness
powers.summary: See normally regardless of lighting, including absolute and magical darkness, for rounds per day equal to half cleric level.

powers.name: Touch of Glory
powers.summary: As a standard action, touch a creature to grant a bonus equal to cleric level on one Charisma-based skill check or Charisma ability check within 1 hour. Uses per day equal 3 + Wisdom modifier.

powers.name: Divine Presence
powers.summary: Emit a 30-foot aura for rounds per day equal to cleric level. Allies within it gain sanctuary with a DC of 10 + half cleric level + Wisdom modifier until they leave or attack.

powers.name: Liberation
powers.summary: Automatically ignore magical effects that impede movement as freedom of movement for a total number of rounds per day equal to cleric level.

powers.name: Freedom's Call
powers.summary: Emit a 30-foot aura for rounds per day equal to cleric level. Allies within it suppress the confused, grappled, frightened, panicked, paralyzed, pinned, and shaken conditions.

powers.name: Vision of Madness
powers.summary: As a melee touch attack, choose attacks, saves, or skill checks. The target gains a bonus equal to half cleric level, minimum +1, on that category and an equal penalty on the other two for 3 rounds. Uses per day equal 3 + Wisdom modifier.

powers.name: Aura of Madness
powers.summary: Emit a 30-foot aura for rounds per day equal to cleric level. Enemies must save each time they enter or become confused while inside; a successful save grants immunity for 24 hours.
